messages:
alex_p: Quick sync — planning a pre-announce for the lab beta. Need to align on hardware timelines (H200 / B200 / MI300 / Gaudi), marketplace listing date, SI integration readiness, and any press embargo windows. Who can commit to dates and test-unit availability?

maria_pm: Can we aim to lock marketplace listing assets by Apr 25? marketing needs images, short copy, and compliance checklist by then.

sam_partnerships: From partnership side: NVIDIA H200 GA target is May 3 in our roadmap. We can ship validation units to the lab the week of Apr 21. Need the test plan and contact for logistics.

nvidia_field: Confirmed — I can coordinate logistics. Will need a secure transfer form + NDA addendum for the lab. Tentative delivery 2026-04-22.

amd_partner: MI300 cadence: partners are receiving initial estuarine boards Apr 28, public availability early May. We can prioritize Redwood for early SW stack if you provide a concise integration TOC.

jin_eng: From eng test side: I updated the compatibility matrix and minimal smoke tests. Priorities: boot/driver compatibility, quantized int8 throughput, long-context KV cache correctness, and memory OOM regression tests.

alex_p: Can you paste the matrix? short version enough for partners.

jin_eng: ```
matrix: [
  hw: H200, B200, MI300, Gaudi
  tests: boot, driver, throughput, int8-quant, kv-cache, oom, perf-regress
  required_env: ubuntu20.04, cuda/rocm kernels, glibc 2.31+
]
notes: gaudi needs updated ROCm-like runtime stub; B200 has different nvlink config.
```

maria_pm: For the marketplace listing we also need: security attestation, CA-signed binaries note (if any), supported regions, and billing SKU mapping. Can infra provide billing SKU by Apr 24?

hw_ops_bot: deploy-bot: Lab capacity reservation confirmed for validation cluster: 2026-04-21 to 2026-04-29. Queue slot: 2 GPU racks.

sam_partnerships: SI partners: we should schedule a 1hr tech enablement on Apr 27 (demo + integration checklist). Also need a short runbook for fallback routes (if H200 unavailable use H100 variant).

alex_p: Good call. Can engineering prepare a 1‑page runbook for SI teams (failover policies, kernel versions, known caveats)? Jin — can you draft by Apr 23?

jin_eng: I can do a draft by Apr 23. Will include: supported model versions, quantization knobs, batching recommendations, and rollback steps.

amd_partner: We'll provide the MI300 runtime notes by Apr 24. Also flagging a driver bug (context size edge-case) that we think is fixed in the next RC — will note in the runbook.

nvidia_field: For press embargos: NVIDIA requests we don't announce joint details until after our partner briefing on May 1. Can Redwood aim for May 5 public announcement?

maria_pm: May 5 public ship works for marketing, gives us time for approvals. We'll prepare a placeholder marketplace listing with "coming soon" and lock assets Apr 25 as discussed.

alex_p: Action items:
- sam_partnerships: confirm logistics + NDA addendum (due Apr 18)
- nvidia_field / amd_partner: driver/runtime notes + test guidance (due Apr 24)
- jin_eng: draft runbook + compatibility matrix short version (due Apr 23)
- maria_pm: placeholder marketplace listing + asset collection (lock Apr 25)
- hw_ops_bot / infra: ensure lab racks & billing SKU (confirm Apr 21)

alex_p: I'll schedule a 30m sync Mon Apr 20 10am PT to walk through the checklist and trade-offs. If anyone can't make it, drop availability here. :calendar: :spiral_calendar: 

maria_pm: I might be OOO morning of Apr 20 — can we do 11am PT instead?

sam_partnerships: 11am PT works for the field team.

jin_eng: 11am PT good.

amd_partner: ok for 11am PT.

nvidia_field: will attend 11am PT.

alex_p: Updated: sync Mon Apr 20 11:00am PT. Invite coming. Thanks all — let's keep updates in this thread so we have a single source of truth. :thumbsup:
